task: Perform a fresh, strictly read-only independent final validation review of BioFabric STEP-02 commit 52b311045be77433cfb92c1a1907dab27c85b482. Do not edit, stage, commit, delete, or create source/test/manifests/workflow artifacts; do not invoke Docker, a verifier, or Git. Inspect the complete interchange implementation and nearby model/session/layout/display/error contracts, especially crates/core/src/io/xml.rs, gw.rs, order.rs, sif.rs, align.rs, annotation.rs, attribute.rs, factory.rs, and json.rs. Re-evaluate lossless/deterministic parse-write behavior wherever formats represent model state; malformed input must be rejected rather than silently lost; standard BIF/XML state and raw opaque plugin payload must stay compatible; GW/order/SIF writers must not emit values their existing readers cannot reversibly parse. Trace the modeled-XML tokenizer and opaque plugInDataSets boundary in detail: exact payload physical lines including meaningful leading/trailing empty/whitespace lines, compact modeled XML, comments/CDATA/PIs containing fake tags/closing literals, malformed comments/PIs, and genuine NetAlignMeasure elements mixed on a physical line with XML Misc. Confirm the new GW CR/LF guards and order grammar delimiter guards cover all writer paths without breaking valid field values. Recheck all prior XML root/context/scalar/declaration, GW raw-comment/complete-record, and SIF strict grammar behavior. ROOT's pinned bridge rustfmt checks passed and cargo test -p biofabric-core --lib yielded 52 passed, with only the three known deferred alignment todo! stubs failing (cycle relation names, position codes, and position map); do not report those named stubs as STEP-02 defects. Produce truthful RESULT.json whose summary begins exactly REVIEW: SHIP, REVIEW: REVISE, or REVIEW: BLOCK and whose evidence contains all exact headings Findings:, Contract coverage:, Questions:, and Verification gaps:. Every confirmed material finding must cite file:line, consequence, and smallest useful correction; keep questions/optional improvements separate. ROOT will decide source acceptance only after reading your report.
